notes.title: Support for Mac OS, Linux and Steam Deck
notes.content: We are proud to announce that our game now supports x64 Mac OS, Linux and Steam Deck without any additional installation and working sound and achievements!

notes.title: Mind Games is now available for Mac
notes.content:
Fellow Mind Gamers and Mac fans!

We are pleased to announce that a Mac version of Mind Games was released today ːsteamhappyː

Have fun, strong brainers!

notes.title: New update!
New update!
Client Update
notes.content:
With March 5th client update we finally solved level progress issues. Entrance puzzle is not considered as a level, so level completion counter starts with second puzzle and achievements will work as expected.
Also this update introduces game localization to following languages (selectable in Steam game properties):
[list]
[*]English
[*]German
[*]Spanish
[*]French
[*]Simplified Chinese
[*]Italian
[*]Korean
[*]Dutch
[*]Portuguese
[*]Russian
[/list]
P.S. We are having some issues with Hindi font and localization so I'd greatly appreciate if someone from native speakers contact me for free beta testing.

notes.title: Client Update
notes.content:
With March 5th client update we finally solved level progress issues. Entrance puzzle is not considered as a level, so level completion counter starts with second puzzle and achievements will work as expected.
Also this update introduces game localization to following languages (selectable in Steam game properties):
[list]
